rationale: The assistant correctly identified E18 as a drainage fault and guided the customer to unplug, drain via the emergency hose, clean the filter and check the impeller. This resolved the fault with no part needed. It handled the wet floor and the impeller feel sensibly, and it escalated only conditionally. Minor flaws: the second reply's opening was slightly garbled, the advice repeated some steps, and it told the customer to 'plug back in' even though the floor had been wet, without first checking the floor was dry near the socket (the third reply did say to wipe up and make sure everything was dry).
